Author: Johnneylee Jack Rollins
Name: Tomestone · Ghostty
Punchline: A phone for your non-combat interface.
Description: Developer preview. One plugin hosts a Nelua/Lua phone shell with Journal, Character, Inventory, Workshop, Correspondence, Grimoire and Ghostty terminals. /phone summons its world projections; /phone hud phases the focused panel onto the HUD. Combat HUD modules are excluded. Native chat is suppressed; combat Enter focuses Grimoire. Lua edits reload automatically. Disable separate copies of the embedded plugins before loading. Some native UI workflows still need adapters and in-game validation.
